title: Mia and Max
text:
Mia has a small dog. His name is Max. Max is brown and very happy. Every morning, Mia gives Max food and water.

Mia also takes Max for a walk in the park. He likes to run and play with the ball. After the walk, Mia cleans his bed. She loves her pet very much.

questions.text: What is the name of Mia's dog?
Where does Mia take Max for a walk?
How does Mia probably feel about Max?
Why does Mia clean Max's bed?
options: Because Max is dirty and she wants him to be comfortable
Because Max does not like the bed
Because she wants to sell the bed

vocabulary.definition: a clear liquid that people and animals drink
a piece of furniture where you sleep or rest

paragraph_translations: Mia tiene un perro pequeño. Su nombre es Max. Max es marrón y muy feliz. Cada mañana, Mia le da comida y agua a Max.
Mia también lleva a Max a pasear al parque. A él le gusta correr y jugar con la pelota. Después del paseo, Mia limpia su cama. Ella quiere mucho a su mascota.
